roles.name: BIM / VDC Manager
roles.description: Directs 3D Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Virtual Design & Construction (VDC) workflows, spatial coordination, and clash detection.
responsibilities: Manage multidisciplinary federated 3D models across architectural, structural, and MEP trades
Lead automated clash detection sessions and resolve spatial interferences prior to field fabrication
Enforce LOD (Level of Development 300-500) compliance and IFC data exchange standards
Integrate 4D construction schedule sequencing and 5D cost extraction into models
roles.careerPath: BIM Coordinator -> BIM / VDC Manager -> Director of Virtual Construction

roles.name: Sustainability & Green Building Consultant
roles.description: Guides low-carbon building designs, LEED and BREEAM certifications, energy modeling, and eco-friendly material selection.
responsibilities: Perform whole-building energy simulations, daylight studies, and carbon footprint assessments
Manage LEED, WELL, and Net-Zero Energy certification filings with USGBC
Audit building envelope insulation, thermal bridging, and HVAC heat recovery systems
Specify sustainable, non-toxic, and circular building materials (EPD/HPD documentation)
roles.careerPath: Sustainability Analyst -> Green Building Consultant -> Director of Sustainable Construction

roles.name: Smart Infrastructure Engineer
roles.description: Integrates IoT telemetry, structural health monitoring sensors, and digital twin monitoring into bridges, roads, and civil assets.
responsibilities: Deploy fiber-optic strain gauges, accelerometers, and tiltmeters on civil structures
Build cloud telemetry dashboards monitoring real-time seismic vibration and structural deflections
Integrate smart transportation systems (ITS), automated tolling, and connected vehicle infrastructure
Formulate predictive maintenance algorithms for municipal asset management
roles.careerPath: Civil Engineer -> Smart Infrastructure Engineer -> Chief Civil Infrastructure Architect

roles.name: Construction Safety Director
roles.description: Enforces jobsite hazard prevention, OSHA safety compliance, accident investigations, and enterprise risk management.
responsibilities: Develop and enforce site-specific safety health environmental plans (HASP) across all job sites
Conduct daily OSHA audits, fall-protection checks, and crane rigging inspections
Lead root-cause investigations of jobsite incidents, near-misses, and OSHA reporting
Conduct mandatory bilingual safety stand-downs, CPR training, and hazard mitigation drills
roles.careerPath: Safety Inspector -> Site Safety Manager -> Construction Safety Director -> VP of Safety & Risk

roles.name: Geotechnical Engineer
roles.description: Analyzes soil mechanics, rock foundations, slope stability, and seismic ground liquefaction for heavy construction.
responsibilities: Plan subsurface soil borings, cone penetration testing (CPT), and standard penetration tests (SPT)
Calculate bearing capacity, deep pile settlement, and lateral earth retaining pressures
Design shoring, dewatering, underpinning, and soil stabilization ground improvement methods
Model slope stability and seismic liquefaction risks using geotechnical finite element software
roles.careerPath: Junior Geotechnical Engineer -> Senior Geotechnical Engineer -> Principal Geotechnical Consultant

roles.name: Structural Forensic Engineer
roles.description: Investigates building failures, concrete cracking, structural collapses, and catastrophic weather damage.
responsibilities: Perform non-destructive testing (NDT), ultrasonic pulse velocity, and concrete core extraction
Reconstruct structural failure mechanisms, progressive collapse pathways, and load overstress
Analyze material fatigue, rebar corrosion, foundation subsidence, and timber rot
Author authoritative expert witness forensic reports and testify in construction litigation
roles.careerPath: Structural Engineer -> Senior Forensic Investigator -> Principal Forensic Engineer

roles.name: Quantity Surveyor
roles.description: Manages all construction project costs, tender bills of quantities (BOQ), commercial contractual valuations, and final accounts.
responsibilities: Prepare detailed Bills of Quantities (BOQ) and accurate material take-offs from drawings
Evaluate subcontractor tender packages, scope variations, and commercial contract terms
Certify monthly interim progress payments, site valuations, and claims for delay
Negotiate final cost accounts and dispute settlements with clients and developers
certifications: MRICS (Member of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors)
roles.careerPath: Assistant Quantity Surveyor -> Quantity Surveyor -> Commercial Manager -> Commercial Director

roles.name: Lean Construction Specialist
roles.description: Applies the Last Planner System, visual pull scheduling, 5S jobsite organization, and waste elimination to building projects.
responsibilities: Facilitate pull planning sessions with trade subcontractors using the Last Planner System (LPS)
Track Percent Plan Complete (PPC) and root-cause analysis for missed milestone commitments
Implement 5S jobsite staging, just-in-time (JIT) material deliveries, and waste elimination
Train project teams on continuous improvement workflows and takt-time construction
certifications: AGC Certificate of Management - Lean Construction (CM-Lean)
roles.careerPath: Lean Coach -> Lean Construction Specialist -> Director of Operational Excellence
